name: Subacromial Bursitis
definition: Inflammation or irritation of the subacromial-subdeltoid bursa, often coexisting with rotator cuff-related shoulder pain.

investigations.principle: Usually clinical; ultrasound may demonstrate bursal fluid/thickening but must be correlated with symptoms.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, physeal, occult injury, deformity or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Injection may be considered selectively but should not replace rehabilitation.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Amsa-Shotha phenotype may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Inflammation or irritation of the subacromial-subdeltoid bursa, often coexisting with rotator cuff-related shoulder pain.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, open injury, severe deformity, rapidly progressive neurological symptoms, suspected infection or other listed red flags.
